d: Aagami 21 navanbar ko pradhanmantri dvara udghatan kie jane vale patna se hajipur sansdiy kshetr men aane vale 6-len pul ka nam 'nitish setu' rakhe jane par bihar kangres ne saval uthae hain. bihar kangres ke varishth neta rajesh rathaur ne is namakran par aapatti jatate hue pul ka nam purv kendriy mantri padmabhushan sv. ramvilas pasvan ke nam par rakhne ki mang ki hai.
